Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, September 9, 2014.

nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

minutes_text:
ACTION MEMO
  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
  AUGUST 11, 2014

Council Chambers  Monday
City Hall  August 11, 2014
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, September 9, 2014.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

CEREMONIAL MATTERS

Swearing-in of Parklands Committee Member Amir Kaviani

ROLL CALL  Members present: Peterson, Rubincam, Wade, Chooljian
  & Kaviani

  Members absent: none

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

Mrs. Harbison, from 916 Via Panorama, spoke concerning a resident inappropriately
planting invasive plants types (i. e. ice plant) in Parklands and questioning if the City
approved.

CITIZEN APPLICATION

1.  PC-356-13: Application to remove or reduce in height 2 Canary Island pine trees
  located in the parkway adjacent to 1104 Via Coronel and 1100 Via Curva

  Applicant:  Christine McNamara
  1228 Via Coronel
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, September 9, 2014.
  Directors approval SR
 Action: Parklands Committee Member Chooljian moved and Committee Member
Wade seconded to deny PC-356-13; application to remove or top one Canary Island
pine located in the parkway adjacent to 1100 Via Curva and one Canary Island pine
tree located adjacent to 1104 Via Coronel. The vote was 5-0.

2.  PC-384-14; Application to remove or reduce in height 4 Canary Island pine trees
  located in the parkway adjacent to 1105, 1108, 1112 Via Coronel and 1100 Via
  Curva

  Applicant:  Christine McNamara
  1228 Via Coronel
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Parklands Committee Member Chooljian moved and Committee Member
seconded to deny PC-384-14; application to remove or top 4 Canary Island pine
trees located adjacent to 1100 Via Curva and 1105, 1108, and 1112 Via Coronel.
The vote was 5-0.

3.  PC-383-14; Application to remove 1 Ficus tree located in the parkway
  adjacent to 808 Tyburn Road

  Applicant:  Joyce Sundin
  808 Tyburn Road
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Parklands Committee Member Wade moved and Committee Member
Chooljian seconded to deny PC-383-14; application to remove one Ficus tree located
in the parkway adjacent to 808 Tyburn Road. The vote was 5-0.

4.  PC-385-14; Application to remove 2 Casurina trees located in the parkway
  adjacent to 3717 Via Palomino

  Applicant:  Shane Andrews
  3717 Via Palomino
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Continued to the September 8, 2014 Parklands Committee meeting.

OLD BUSINESS

5.  Review of the landscape at the first center median of Palos Verdes Drive West

Parklands Committee members requested input from the Lunada Bay
Homeowners’ Association.

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, September 9, 2014.
  Directors approval SR
 6.  Review of the landscape at the Entrance from Rancho Palos Verdes at
  Montemalaga

Action: Parklands Committee Member Peterson moved and Committee Member
Wade seconded to recommend completion of the landscape as presented. The vote
was 5-0.

NEW BUSINESS

7.  Discussion of Bluff Cove homes project

The Parklands Committee requested to continue the Bluff Cove homes discussion to
September to allow the Committee to review the trees with the Planning Director
and a member of staff.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM THE COMMITTEE/STAFF

8.  Update of the landscape at the Entrance to the Lunada Bay commercial area from
  Palos Verdes Drive West - Reviewed and filed.

9.  Update on 2014 applications - Reviewed and filed.

ADJOURNMENT TO SEPTEMBER 8, 2014

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, September 9, 2014.
  Directors approval SR
